name: Savory bowl noodle soup, lobster
ingredientsText: Enriched wheat flour (wheat flour, niacin, reduced iron, thiamine mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), palm oil, potato starch, modified potato starch, salt, maltodextrin, contains less than 2% of each of the following: artificial lobster flavor, beef extract*, beef fat*, beef stock*, black pepper*, clam*, corn syrup*, crab extract*, cuttlefish*, dehydrated vegetables (carrot, green cabbage), dextrose, disodium guanylate, disodium inosinate, disodium succinate, freeze dried imitation crab (pollock, potato starch, d-sorbitol, sugar, salt, hydrolyzed soy protein, color), garlic*, ginger*, hydrolyzed soy protein, modified tapioca starch, mushroom extract*, mussel*, natural flavors, onion*, oyster*, parsley flakes, potassium carbonate, radish extract*, red chili pepper*, riboflavin (color), rice flour, sand lance concentrate*, sea squirt*, shrimp extract*, sodium carbonate, sodium phosphates, soy sauce (soy, wheat, salt), soybeans*, sugar, tocopherols (antioxidant), tuna extract*, yeast extract, yellow corn flour.
notes: Clam, mussel, oyster, cuttlefish and sea squirt are molluscs, not shellfish here; shellfish comes from crab extract and shrimp extract. Fish from pollock, sand lance, tuna extract.
